newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan officially congratulates HK future leader.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan officially congratulates HK future leader.

text.p: Taiwan formally congratulated Hong Kong's newly selected leader-in-waiting on Wednesday, predicting shipping mogul Tung Chee-hwa would profoundly affect the territory's future under Chinese rule.

"We would like to congratulate Mr Tung's high-vote victory," the cabinet's Mainland Affairs council said in a statement. "Mr Tung's victory will have a profound influence on Hong Kong's peaceful transition and its freedom and prosperity."

Taipei had "consistently cared about Hong Kong's freedom, stability and prosperity" and believed Tung, chosen in Hong Kong on Wednesday by a Beijing-selected panel, would have "excellent achievements" in his five-year term, the council said.
"We hope Mr Tung can continue his efforts to promote harmonious and stable Taiwan-Hong Kong relations to maintain and strengthen bilateral contacts and cooperation," it said.
"Mutually beneficial Taiwan-Hong Kong relations have a great importance on economic prosperity and social stability in Hong Kong, Taiwan and mainland China," it said.

The warmth of Taiwan's statement contrasted sharply with a November assessment by council spokesman Kao Koong-lian that the Beijing-orchestrated process to select Hong Kong's future leaders was "a big joke".
